threats.name: universal sufficiency confused with universal minimality
threats.description: Misread FAR-CORE-004 as denying that identity is sufficient for every contract rather than denying one simultaneous least-informative representation.
threats.protected_boundary: FAR-CORE-004 corrected v1.1 statement and identity nonclaim
threats.detection: assurance ledger must retain both no_contract_free_simultaneous_minimum and identity_is_universally_sufficient
threats.negative_control: delete the identity-sufficiency declaration or use the v1.0 ambiguous wording
threats.expected_failure: registry/assurance validation reports missing FAR-CORE-004 scope guard

threats.name: Gamma frame residue confused with exact common theory
threats.description: Treat Gamma as a direct index of exact T while L, J, I, and interpreted models are fixed.
threats.detection: formalization and assurance must distinguish commonTheory from frame-indexed Residue
threats.negative_control: insert Gamma into the exact-theory dependency list as an independent index
threats.expected_failure: status/assurance validation rejects the contradictory dependency mapping

threats.name: preference orientation silently assumed in Pareto reasoning
threats.description: Construct dominance or a frontier on dimensions that have no externally justified better direction.
threats.detection: contract comparisons require an explicit orientation and provenance per dimension
threats.negative_control: label an unoriented tradeoff axis as maximized or minimized
threats.expected_failure: future contract-schema linter must reject the comparison

threats.name: finite-panel result universalized
threats.description: Promote finite enumeration, bounded fixtures, or a target panel to open-domain universality.
threats.protected_boundary: FAR-CORE-009 and P6 no universality by finite induction
threats.detection: claims sourced only by finite execution may not use universal/open-domain status
threats.negative_control: set empirical finite evidence as a proof artifact for an unrestricted claim

threats.name: encoding confused with structure
threats.description: Infer native, explanatory, necessary, or minimal common structure from injective host capacity and a decoder.
threats.detection: capacity records must include the charged encoder/decoder and native-structure nonclaim
threats.negative_control: promote OPP-038 from REJECTED or omit decoder machinery

threats.name: Unknown confused with absence
threats.description: Collapse epistemic Unknown, determinate absence, failure, inapplicability, or unresolvedness when the contract observes the distinction.
threats.detection: schemas and assurance records keep separate values and collision tests
threats.negative_control: map absent and unknown to one result in the finite playground fixture

threats.name: decoder power silently strengthened
threats.description: Allow a decoder to inspect the source state, hidden metadata, live oracle, or answer not contained in the declared representation.
threats.protected_boundary: FAR-CORE-001 image-level decoder and FAR-CORE-014 bounded decoder class
threats.detection: decoder inputs and external machinery must be explicit and versioned
threats.negative_control: let an SSS successor-set decoder inspect the sequent or recompute provability
threats.expected_failure: SSS scope/alignment control rejects the stronger decoder class

threats.name: historical provenance status confused with truth status
threats.description: Read FAR-CORE-014 supported_derived provenance as a non-proof truth verdict or overwrite it with the W1 truth verdict.
threats.protected_boundary: dimension-separated assurance ledger and W1 promotion record
threats.detection: truth PROVED and provenance supported_derived coexist in distinct fields
threats.negative_control: require canonical claim-ledger status to equal the W1 truth verdict string

threats.name: contract silently changed
threats.description: Repair a failing representation by changing tests, outcomes, decoder class, parameters, or equivalence without versioning the contract.
threats.detection: contract/question hash is immutable within a campaign and mutations require a new version
threats.negative_control: change a frozen target hash while retaining the campaign identity

threats.name: scope qualifier dropped
threats.description: Report a bounded theorem or application without its domain, state type, transition representation, decoder, profile, or finite restriction.
threats.protected_boundary: scope travels with every claim and declaration
threats.detection: assurance, formalization, and graph nodes require nonempty exact scope
threats.negative_control: remove PR #453 decoder/state restrictions from FAR-CORE-014
threats.expected_failure: assurance alignment validation reports scope mismatch

threats.name: prior-art absence mistaken for novelty
threats.description: Infer novelty or priority from an empty, bounded, negative, or tool-assisted search.
threats.protected_boundary: novelty unresolved and citation authority split
threats.detection: no registry status allows novelty certification from search absence
threats.negative_control: set novelty established while W1 final says novelty_or_priority_certified false

threats.name: model agreement mistaken for proof
threats.description: Promote unanimous or calibrated reasoner output, CI, or replay agreement to theorem closure.
threats.protected_boundary: models are replaceable reviewers; proof and adjudication remain separate
threats.detection: harness adjudication hard-codes reasoner_vote_used_as_proof false and assurance proof sources exclude votes
threats.negative_control: adjudicate a claim solely by provider majority
threats.expected_failure: harness/adjudication validation rejects vote-based proof authority
